rca of the issue: Previous iteration: ReferenceTable was rendered inside the success branch of an isError ternary in /app/components/chat/chat-view.tsx, so it was hidden when the API returned a 503 safe-error with references. Fix hoisted the ReferenceTable render outside the ternary; now it renders whenever message.references is non-empty, regardless of error state. Verified via live run: 503 returned, error alert visible, references table visible with correct 2 rows.
